children: A BTG Pactual/Nexus poll put Bolsonaro's support at 50.5% and Lula's at 49.5%, within the 2-percentage-point margin of error and little changed from Monday, when the right-wing challenger led by less than 1 percentage point. According to Sina Finance, Brazilians will vote Sunday to choose their next leader. Bolsonaro's unexpected first-round victory over Lula on October 4 made the senator a favorite to win the presidency. The candidates traded accusations over corruption and clashed on the economy and public safety during their final televised debate on Friday. Both attended rallies in three major Brazilian cities on Saturday.

title: BTG Pactual/Nexus Poll Gives Bolsonaro 50.5% Support, Lula 49.5% Ahead of Brazil Vote
